description: Apply the same backdrop-in-player concept to the mobile surface. The mobile DetailHero currently shows the backdrop as a large ImageBackground. Move the backdrop to be behind the player/play-button area. On mobile, the detail screens navigate to a separate player screen, so the backdrop should appear as a preview in the detail page's play area and optionally as a background in the player screen itself.
steps: Create apps/mobile/src/components/PlayerBox.jsx: A new component similar to the web PlayerBox. It renders an ImageBackground with the backdrop_url, dark gradient overlays, and a centered play button. Props: item, onPlay. Uses the same styling approach as the existing mobile DetailHero backdrop (ImageBackground with overlay Views) but in a 16:9 aspect-ratio container.

Modify apps/mobile/src/components/DetailHero.jsx: Remove the large ImageBackground backdrop section (the 350px tall backdrop). Keep the info section (poster, title, metadata, genres, overview). Adjust styling so the info section appears on a clean dark background without the backdrop.
Modify apps/mobile/src/app/movie/[id].jsx: Import and render the new PlayerBox component above the DetailHero, passing `movie` as item and `handlePlay` as onPlay.
Modify apps/mobile/src/app/tv/[id].jsx: Import and render the new PlayerBox component above the DetailHero, passing `show` as item and `handlePlay` as onPlay.
Optionally modify apps/mobile/src/app/player.jsx: Add the backdrop_url as a subtle background behind the WebView (using ImageBackground wrapping the VideoPlayer container) for visual continuity.
Verify: Run `bunx expo lint` in apps/mobile to check for errors.
acceptance_criteria: A new PlayerBox component exists in apps/mobile/src/components/PlayerBox.jsx that shows backdrop with play button
Mobile DetailHero no longer shows the large backdrop image - only info on dark background
Movie and TV detail screens show PlayerBox with backdrop above the info section
findings: All changes lint cleanly. Created PlayerBox.jsx with 16:9 aspect ratio backdrop and centered play button. Removed ImageBackground backdrop from DetailHero (removed the 350px backdrop and gradient overlays, removed marginTop: -60 from posterRow). Added PlayerBox above DetailHero in both movie/[id].jsx and tv/[id].jsx. Player screen now uses ImageBackground with poster_url as subtle background behind VideoPlayer.
